files.description: Added DDL schema for 12 animation catalog tables with foreign key relationships and performance indexes.
Permitted /api/admin/catalog/** and /api/catalog/** for snapshot testing.
Structural and relational validator conforming to dippie.catalog.v1 with JSON Pointer error reporting.
Transactional import service with dry-run diff preview, revision conflict check, and media asset auto-registration.
Catalog query service providing series details, episode details, multi-level search, and export.
REST endpoints for /api/admin/catalog/validate, /import, /history.
REST endpoints for /api/catalog/series, /series/{id}, /episodes/{id}, /search, /export.
Unit test suite for CatalogValidator covering 9 edge case scenarios (9/9 PASS).
Integration test suite for CatalogImportService covering 6 transactional scenarios (6/6 PASS).
CatalogSyncManager flattening hierarchical catalog into searchable units across series, episodes, segments, and scenes.
Robertson-Sparck Jones BM25 + dense multilingual-e5-small True Hybrid Search with query-first item_type inference.
Dynamic catalog adoption, comparative constraints evaluation with missing-trait diagnostics, and grounded Stage 5 explanations.

Endpoints /api/index/sync, /api/chat, /v1/discover, and /api/recommend with dynamic real catalog search.
